newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks set new record after U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks set new record after U.S. data.

text.p: French stocks climbed sharply to set a record after the U.S. fourth-quarter employment cost index showed the cost of labour rose 0.8 percent, slightly weaker than economists predicted.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index jumped on the news, trading up as high as 2,464.89, up more than 1.2 percent. At 1340 GMT it was up 28.20 points or 1.16 percent, at 2,463.37.
Economists in a Reuter poll had predicted the U.S. employment cost index would show a 0.9 percent rise for the fourth quarter.
